name: keling-monorepo
description: 课灵 - 多端知识管理应用

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=keling-server" "npm run dev --workspace=keling-web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=keling-web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=keling-server
scripts.dev:android: echo '请在 Android Studio 中打开 apps/android 目录运行'
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=keling-web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=keling-server
scripts.check: npm run repo:check && npm run assets:check && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.test:web: node --test scripts/test-guest-data.cjs scripts/test-guest-ai.cjs scripts/guest-workspace.test.cjs && npm run test:expedition --workspace=keling-web
